evidence_span.text: Zebrafish mutants for the chemokine receptor cxcr4a or its ligand cxcl12b establish a decreased number of arterial-venous connections

reviews.rationale: Cxcr4a mutation causally reduces arterial-venous connections during zebrafish brain vascularization. The different species makes the context indirect rather than partial.

evidence_span.text: Overall, our findings reveal a key role for PC ALK5 in regulating brain endothelial morphogenesis

reviews.rationale: Pericyte-specific Alk5 depletion causally establishes regulation of brain endothelial morphogenesis. Because the perturbation is embryonic and pericyte-localized rather than postnatal endothelial, the context is partial.

evidence_span.text: In the present study we demonstrate the ability of OPG to support endothelial cell survival, as well as the formation of cord-like structures in vitro using a matrigel tubule formation assay.

reviews.rationale: Gene-specific OPG evidence supports endothelial survival and angiogenic cord formation. The human tumor and in-vitro setting is indirect to postnatal mouse brain endothelium.

evidence_span.text: More importantly, Cdc42EP3 is required for most of the hallmarks of CAFs, notably extracellular matrix remodelling and promotion of angiogenesis

reviews.rationale: This review reports gene-specific Cdc42EP3 involvement in stromal remodeling and promotion of angiogenesis. It supports the assigned function secondarily in an indirect cancer-associated fibroblast context.
